values.note: Every individual site is first come, first served, claimed in person; there is no availability by phone. Only the group site (up to 75 people) is reserved, on recreation.gov 232214.

values.note: Single site $27, double $54, group $150. Extra people are charged at the campground.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/florida-campground ('Single Site: $27 per night | Double Site: $54 per night | Group Site: $150 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232214/rates (2026 Peak Season $27 / $54 / $150), read 2026-10-28

note: San Juan NF (Columbine RD), along the Florida ('Floor-ee-da') River above Lemon Reservoir, reached via CR 240/243. Shaded sites under blue spruce, Douglas fir and aspen; private land adjoins the south side, no trespassing. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: confirmed 20 FCFS sites, max RV 25 ft (agency figure, 'Max RV size = 25 feet'), short pull-throughs, vault toilets, potable water, no hookups, $27. Booking corrected: individual sites are never reservable (only the group site is), so reservable true/some_sites -> false/always; 14-night max added. Season May-Sept (2026: May 8 - Sept 12). Pin ~425 m south of the campground loops. Note trimmed.
flags: Pin: stored 37.44941,-107.68026 sits on the county road ~425 m SSE of the campground; the FS point 37.4528,-107.6825 is on the west loop. recreation.gov has coordinates only for the group site (37.46132,-107.65381, ~2.7 km NE, likely wrong). Suggest re-pinning to ~37.4528,-107.6825.

Waterfront (stored riverfront): the Florida River runs between the two loops as a rocky channel ~10-20 m wide at the campground (bridge at the north end), with loop spurs reaching to it - by the size rule (under ~30 m) that is creekside, not riverfront. Re-audit lead; not changed.
Missing phone: Columbine Ranger District (970) 884-2512 (FS page; office open Fridays only). Concessionaire (recreation.gov) line (661) 702-1420.

FS page carried a 'Site Closed' status on 2026-10-28 - consistent with the season end (recreation.gov 2026 season ended Sept 12), not an alert; the San Juan alerts list nothing for the campground or CR 243 (only Lemon Reservoir restrictions).
Max length: 25 ft is the FS's own figure; the FS also says only 'a few short pull-thru and back-in sites can accommodate larger RVs' - a 23-ft rig fits under the posted limit.
